name: kicad-eda
description: Concept-to-Gerbers PCB design for KiCad 9/10/11. Two workflows: a fully HEADLESS gated pipeline (netlist.json -> schematic+ERC via the KiCad 11 API or the file writer -> SWIG board build -> routing by Claude on the KiCad 11 board API, Freerouting as the fallback -> DRC -> fab zip, with IEEE 15288.2-style self-remediating gates), and a GUI-assisted 10-stage flow. Bundles the kicad-generator MCP server, gate-reviewer and router subagents, IPC-2221/2141A rules math, the Freerouting 1.9 autorouter jar, and cross-platform guardrail hooks.

kicad_path.title: KiCad install path
kicad_path.description: Optional: one more KiCad install root to add to auto-discovery. The plugin discovers every installed KiCad by itself and picks per job — the newest for schematics/ERC, the one with a bundled Python (pcbnew) for board builds, the KiCad that wrote a board file for its DRC/Gerbers, the KiCad 11 nightly for the schematic and board APIs — so leave this blank unless KiCad lives somewhere unusual.

fab_profile.title: Default fab house
fab_profile.description: Design-rule profile applied during DRC and Gerber export.
